subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently retire the standalone Talk destination and make Chat the only conversational surface for text, dictation, voice notes, and realtime voice?
rationale: The implementation changes a shipped navigation and launch-alias contract; tests can establish correctness, but they cannot choose whether existing users should lose the dedicated Talk surface.

options.title: Approve unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the sole conversational destination, retain the compatibility aliases and legacy decoders, and require exact-head Apple-platform validation before merge.

options.title: Preserve the Talk destination
options.body: Keep the existing Talk tab or an equivalent dedicated route while adopting only the session-ownership and Live Activity hardening from this branch.

options.title: Pause and split the work
options.body: Separate session-safety fixes from the product-navigation redesign so the correctness improvements can land without deciding the permanent Talk experience.

recommendation.title: Approve unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the sole conversational destination, retain the compatibility aliases and legacy decoders, and require exact-head Apple-platform validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS gateway and application lifecycle ownership most directly overlaps the voice-permission, routing, and upgrade behavior that needs approval.
